purpose: Force one canonical deploy-applicable website canary so Netlify production can be read back against the protected merge SHA without weakening paths-ignore semantics.
root_cause: Recent main commits were intentionally non-deploying governance/backend changes, so production correctly remained on the latest deploy-applicable ancestor rather than matching repository HEAD.
correction: Use the existing website delivery lane with one invisible index.html source canary and preserve the existing deployment applicability policy.
terminal_evidence_required: Netlify preview green with no secret matches
Netlify production ready with commit_ref equal to merge SHA
